The family members of one patient with a KRIT1 variant (K7), and two patients with PDCD10 variants (P1 and P2), received genetic testing, and four family members with the same variant as the proband were detected. Furthermore, these family members had CCM lesions confirmed by brain MRI.
the burden of the KRIT1 group was aggravated faster than that of the Mutation not detected group

pairs.reason: The causal claim is the authors' background statement (b0003/b0011), not tested by this study. This study's own results are consistent with it: 9 of 21 FCCM patients carried heterozygous KRIT1 variants classified LP or previously reported (Table 2), the K7 variant co-segregated with MRI-confirmed CCM in the mother, and the KRIT1 group showed a steeper age-lesion correlation (r = 0.75). A retrospective case series cannot by itself establish causality.
